{{Season|Winter}} |Weather = Any weather |Difficulty = 85 |Behavior = Mixed |Size = 5 - 9 in |XP = 32 |Edibility = 40 |base = 250 |Roe = yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of [[Fish]] that can only be caught after players have seen several events. It can be caught at the river at [[Shearwater Bridge]] during {{Season|Fall}} and {{Season|Winter}} in any weather, between the hours of 10:00 am to 5:00 pm. The minimum required fishing level is 8. Preconditions: * Has learned to read Junimo Text * Has viewed [[Stardew:Willy|Willy's]] event where he tells the player to fish at Shearwater Bridge * Has viewed [[Alesia|Alesia's]] and [[Isaac|Isaac's]] intro event in the railway before entering the [[Crimson Badlands]] * Has viewed [[Camilla|Camilla's]] event on Shearwater Bridge {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Map== {|class="wikitable" |style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Shearwater Bridge.png|center|500px]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|Shearwater Bridge - Fishing Zones |} {{clear}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift item, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |like=Abigail, Wizard |neutral=Demetrius, Elliott, Linus, Pam, Sebastian, Willy |hate=Evelyn, Haley, Martin, Pierre, Sophia }} ==Fish Pond== {{#lst:Fish|Kittyfish}} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not specifically used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes but can be used in recipes calling for "Any Fish." ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|white}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces a white color. {{Navbox Fish}} [[Category:Fish]] [[zh:小猫鱼]]
